First release of **OneShot Remote SSH**, a fork of [Open Remote - SSH](https://github.com/jeanp413/open-remote-ssh) v0.5.0.

Server setup runs as a single SSH command, so hosts that put MFA on every SSH session (e.g. Duo `ForceCommand login_duo`) prompt **once** per connection instead of four times.

### Install
Close the editor, then:
- Linux / macOS: `curl -fsSLO https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GuyliandeJong/oneshot-remote-ssh/main/install/install.sh && bash install.sh`
- Windows: download `install/install.ps1` and run `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install.ps1`

Then, per host:
```json
"remote.SSH.remotePlatform": { "myserver": "linux" },
"remote.SSH.remoteArch":     { "myserver": "x86_64" }
```

### Added
- `remote.SSH.remoteArch` setting (skips the `uname -m` probe)
- install scripts that also enable the proposed API in `argv.json`

### Changed
- `"serverVersion": "latest"` resolves via the GitHub `releases/latest` redirect instead of the rate-limited API
- new extension ID `guyliandejong.oneshot-remote-ssh`, name, icon, command category `OneShot SSH`

### Fixed
- GitHub API errors (e.g. rate limit) are reported instead of failing with `.map is not a function`

**Note:** the new ID requires `"enable-proposed-api": ["guyliandejong.oneshot-remote-ssh"]` in `~/.vscode-oss/argv.json`; the install scripts add it. Do not install alongside Open Remote - SSH or Microsoft Remote-SSH.
